ui.settings.webdav.title: WebDAV mount
ui.settings.webdav.desc: Mount the drive as a network disk in Windows Explorer / macOS Finder / RaiDrive / rclone.
ui.settings.webdav.path_hint: Must start with /; /api and /ping are reserved. Changes take effect immediately, so update your client too.
ui.settings.webdav.unc_hint: Use "Add a network location" or net use — "Map network drive" cannot mount an https URL. For non-443 ports write \\host@SSL@port\dav.
ui.settings.webdav.windows_hint: Windows only allows Basic auth over HTTPS by default: for plain HTTP on a LAN set BasicAuthLevel=2 in the registry. A self-signed certificate must be trusted on the client first, otherwise Explorer says the folder is invalid. See FAQ → WebDAV.
ui.settings.webdav.warn_title: Use it over HTTPS or on a fully trusted network only
ui.settings.webdav.warn_body: WebDAV clients usually support only Basic auth, so the username and password are resent with every request — over plain HTTP that means repeated cleartext credentials. Superadmin accounts are rejected; connect with a team member account.
